comment: Night Elf saga (issue #14): Shadowglen, Teldrassil, Darnassus, Darkshore and the first steps in Ashenvale. Text only; every name, level and point comes from the facts.

chains.name: The Balance of Shadowglen
chains.summary: The Balance of Shadowglen in Teldrassil runs through Conservator Ilthalaine, Tarindrella, Dirania Silvershine and Gilshalan Windwalker at Aldrassil.

quests.task: Kill 7 Young Nightsabers and 4 Young Thistle Boars, then return to Conservator Ilthalaine.
Cast Elune's Light and Shadowmeld, then return to Shanda.
Leave Melithar Staghelm and seek out the dryad Tarindrella.
Collect 4 Gnarlpine Totems and bring them to Tarindrella.
Kill 7 Mangy Nightsabers and 7 Thistle Boars, then return to Conservator Ilthalaine.
Collect 8 Fel Moss and bring them to Tarindrella.
Collect 10 Webwood Venom Sacs, then bring them to Gilshalan Windwalker at Aldrassil.
Leave Dirania Silvershine and find Iverron by the cave to the north.
Leave Iverron and speak to Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen.
Collect 7 Hyacinth Mushrooms, 4 Moonpetal Lilies and 1 Webwood Ichor, then return to Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen.
Bring Iverron's Antidote to Iverron by the cave to the north before the time limit runs out.
Bring a Webwood Egg to Gilshalan Windwalker at Aldrassil.
Leave Gilshalan Windwalker and speak with Tenaron Stormgrip atop Aldrassil.

chains.name: Crown of the Earth
chains.summary: Crown of the Earth runs across Teldrassil from Tenaron Stormgrip atop Aldrassil through Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar to Fandral Staghelm, Lariia and Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.

quests.task: Fill the Crystal Phial, then bring it back to Tenaron Stormgrip atop Aldrassil.
Bring the Partially Filled Vessel to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
Fill the Jade Phial, then bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
Fill the Tourmaline Phial, then bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
Fill the Amethyst Phial, then bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
Bring the Filled Vessel to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
Bring the Drained Vessel to Lariia in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
Bring the Moonwell Remnants to Tyrande Whisperwind in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

chains.name: The Gnarlpine Corruption
chains.summary: In Teldrassil, Athridas Bearmantle of Dolanaar sends an errand to Gaerolas Talvethren of Starbreeze Village, then calls for the Relics of Wakening and the death of Ursal the Mauler.

quests.task: Leave Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar and seek out Gaerolas Talvethren in Starbreeze Village.
Return to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.
Retrieve the Relics of Wakening and bring them to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.
Kill Ursal the Mauler, then return to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.

chains.name: Denalan's Timberlings
chains.summary: Denalan tends his work at Lake Al'Ameth in Teldrassil, gathering Timberling seeds and sprouts and sending a seed to Rellian Greenspyre in Darnassus.

quests.task: Take the package of Rare Earth from Syral Bladeleaf to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
Collect 8 Timberling Seeds, then return to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
Collect 12 Timberling Sprouts, then return to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
Take a Timberling Seed from Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth to Rellian Greenspyre in Darnassus.
Collect 5 Mossy Tumors, then return to Rellian Greenspyre in Darnassus.
Leave Rellian Greenspyre in Darnassus and speak with Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
Take the Gargantuan Tumor from Oakenscowl, then return to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.

chains.name: The Temple of the Moon
chains.summary: In Darnassus, Sister Aquinne sends word to Priestess A'moora of the Temple of the Moon, who calls for Lady Sathrah's Silvery Spinnerets to be offered at the temple fountain.

quests.task: Leave Laurna Morninglight in Teldrassil and speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.
Leave Sister Aquinne and speak with Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon.
Bring Lady Sathrah's Silvery Spinnerets to Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon.
Place Lady Sathrah's Silvery Spinnerets at the fountain inside the Temple of the Moon, then return to Priestess A'moora.

chains.name: The Enchanted Glade
chains.summary: In the Oracle Glade of Teldrassil, Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak calls for Bloodfeather Belts and three amulets, and the Oracle Tree's report goes to Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

quests.task: Collect 6 Bloodfeather Belts, then return to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet, then return to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
Leave Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak and find the Oracle Tree Bark nearby to receive its message.
Carry the Oracle Tree's report from the Oracle Tree Bark to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

chains.name: Bashal'Aran
chains.summary: In the ruins of Bashal'Aran in Darkshore, a strange blue aura named by Thundris Windweaver leads to Asterion, who seeks Grell Earrings and the Ancient Moonstone Seal for the ancient flame in Ameth'Aran.

quests.task: Leave Thundris Windweaver and find the source of the strange blue aura in the ruins of Bashal'Aran.
Collect 8 Grell Earrings in Bashal'Aran, then return to Asterion.
Obtain the Ancient Moonstone Seal, then bring it to Asterion in Bashal'Aran.
Destroy the Ancient Moonstone Seal at the ancient flame in Ameth'Aran, then return to Asterion in Bashal'Aran.

chains.name: Flight to Auberdine
chains.summary: Nessa Shadowsong in Teldrassil sends Nessa's Collection by way of Vesprystus to Laird in Auberdine, and Laird's Response returns to her.

quests.task: Leave Mydrannul in Darnassus and speak with Nessa Shadowsong.
Take Nessa's Collection from Nessa Shadowsong to Vesprystus.
Ride a hippogryph from Vesprystus to Auberdine, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.
Take Laird's Response from Laird in Auberdine back to Nessa Shadowsong in Teldrassil.

chains.name: How Big a Threat?
chains.summary: In Darkshore, Terenthis of Auberdine asks how big a threat the corrupt furbolgs pose, while Thundris Windweaver calls for samples from the Cliffspring River and the northern Blackwood camps, and Volcor is sought.

quests.task: Find a corrupt furbolg camp in Darkshore, then return to Terenthis in Auberdine.
Kill 8 Blackwood Pathfinders and 5 Windtalkers, then return to Terenthis in Auberdine.
Speak with Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.
Draw a sample from the pool at the first waterfall along the Cliffspring River, north of Auberdine, then return it to Thundris Windweaver.

Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell and gather fruit, nut and grain from the northern Blackwood camps. Mix the bowl by the bonfire nearest the Cliffspring River, then bring the Talisman of Corruption to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.
Find 5 Fine Moonstalker Pelts, then return them to Terenthis in Auberdine.
Find Volcor in Darkshore and give him the Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak.
Escape the furbolg cave, then meet Terenthis in Auberdine.

chains.name: The Master's Glaive
chains.summary: In Darkshore, Barithras Moonshade of Auberdine points the way to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients, who asks after the Master's Glaive and the Mathystra Relics.

quests.task: Bring 5 Scaber Stalks and 1 Death Cap to Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine.
Speak with Onu at the Grove of the Ancients.
Gather information, then use the Phial of Scrying to create a Scrying Bowl and speak with Onu through it.
Find a clue in the Twilight's Hammer camp at the Master's Glaive.
Bring the Insane Scribbles from the Twilight Tome to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients.
Bring 6 Mathystra Relics to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients.

chains.name: Expanding Horizons
chains.summary: Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine, Darkshore, sends a letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind City, and a reply travels back to Auberdine.

quests.task: Take Thundris' Letter from Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.
Carry Alexston's Reply from Baros Alexston in Stormwind back to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

chains.name: The Absent Minded Prospector
chains.summary: In Darkshore, Archaeologist Hollee of Auberdine seeks Prospector Remtravel, and a mysterious fossil travels from his search to Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus and Archaeologist Flagongut in Menethil Harbor.

quests.task: Travel south through Darkshore and check on Prospector Remtravel.
Protect Prospector Remtravel as he searches for the mysterious fossil, then return to Archaeologist Hollee in Auberdine.
Take the mysterious fossil from Archaeologist Hollee to Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus.
Take the mysterious fossil from Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker to Archaeologist Flagongut in Menethil Harbor.

chains.name: Trek to Ashenvale
chains.summary: In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner and Shindrell Swiftfire of Astranaar set the work, and the search for Teronis leads to the Glowing Gem and Shael'dryn at a moonwell.

quests.task: Travel from Darkshore to Ashenvale and find Raene Wolfrunner.
Collect 20 Wrathtail Heads, then return to Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar.
Search Ashenvale for Teronis, as Raene Wolfrunner asked.
Find the Glowing Gem, then return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar with Teronis' Journal.
Find Shael'dryn at the moonwell to the northeast.

routeTasks.65: Leave Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands for Westfall and find Gryan Stoutmantle in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill. Begin his investigation: seek the contact who owes him a favor and can speak of the Brotherhood's leadership.
